working_days.count: Day 1 is the first working day after receipt

assumptions: Every body takes the longest extension the rules allow.
Every reply is a refusal or a non-answer, so every review and escalation step is needed.

Our side acts on fixed dates: a chaser the working day after any lapse, a review request 5 working days after a refusal, a regulator complaint 5 working days after a review outcome, and never later than the hard date.
